strategy_settings._comment_pullback: enable_pullback_entry allows re-entering trends on dips. Vital for Morning Trend Continuation.
strategy_settings._comment_gap: Cool-down timer applied per-instrument after CLOSING a trade. Does not block pyramiding.

strike_selection._comment_expiry: auto_switch helps avoid 0DTE volatility by moving to next expiry on Thursday.

active_indicators._comment_indicators: EMA on HTF automatically detects trend (9 vs 21 crossover). Available: ema, stochrsi, rsi, utbot

risk_management._comment_capital: Capital in ₹ to allocate per trade (e.g., 10000).
risk_management._comment_sl: Fixed Stop Loss % from entry price (e.g., 30 = 30%).
risk_management._comment_tsl: Trailing Stop % (trails peak price by this amount, e.g., 5%).
risk_management._comment_lock: Profit Lock: If profit > activation %, lock profit at lock %. (e.g., if >3%, lock 1%).
risk_management._comment_loss: Set to 0 to disable daily loss limit. Otherwise, bot stops new trades if loss exceeds this amount.
risk_management._comment_positions: Maximum number of simultaneous open positions.

general._comment_live_trading: Set to true for REAL trading (requires OpenAlgo setup). False = Paper trading with MockAPI (safe default).
